reason: Safety-first cleanup constraints: risk grading, no blind delete of cache internals without official command, trash/inspect-only rules for new global caches.
Rust module conventions for adding src/rules.rs and registering it in lib.rs.
Centralizing scattered scanner/provider rule branches into one declarative table; pre-modification search before changing rule constants.
Rule table is consumed across scanner, providers, TUI render_rules, and CLI run_rules; keep one shared contract, avoid local casts of rule fields.
render_rules must stay a pure render function and be TestBackend-verifiable when it switches to iterating rule_catalogue().
